en: Sepia photograph mounted on a postcard showing a small chapel with a simple gabled façade, bell-cote, and round rose window above a double wooden door. Four men stand in front of the entrance on a bare, slightly snowy slope, with leafless trees and a bench visible to the sides. The image is framed in an oval on a white card. Handwritten captions on the card read "S. Lucia presso Fonds." and "1920."
